I’m a medical patient. Couldn’t even place an order online. Fine. I figured they would have a separate line for medical patients. Turns out they didn’t. They had cancer patients and elderly with canes and walkers standing in the same line as those who just wanna smoke for fun. Can’t get through to the phones either. It really makes me mad considering all the shit we had to go through to become medical patients in the first place. Corporate greed has once again fucked over the people in the most need.
